protocol.training: train-only synthetic curriculum plus real train anchors; no memory or stored traces in policy rollout
protocol.supervision: teacher-forced training-only traces; fixed target-minus-current byte sketch after THINK
protocol.validation_selection: only final-stage epochs; maximize real validation exact fraction, break ties by normalized byte similarity; earliest on ties
protocol.test_inference: greedy autonomous cognitive_generate; no memory, controller, stored trace, instruction, target or target-derived budget; baseline, validation-selected and last-epoch policies evaluated after selection
protocol.real_fixture_limitation: the real held-out pairs do not include actionable edit requests; source alone underdetermines the desired target
protocol.guard_limit: hash guard checks registered raw bytes and trace states, not model-weight history or semantic duplicates
